source.note: common.md (Diagram detection): the first `%%{` starts no directive in the source, so the diagram text starts with it and the input is rejected here; the second directive scan of mermaid.js finds a directive from the first `%%{` to `x}%%` and detects a flowchart, but its flowchart lexer reads the text without that removal and rejects it, so both reject the input.
